title: Torricelli's tube tilted (হেলানো টরিসেলির নল)
placement: Book page 146, topic 5.4.1 (টরিসেলির পরীক্ষা): beside চিত্র ৫.১০, after the paragraph on the 76 cm column, as a check that the column's height is vertical.
description: Torricelli's tube tilted (page 146, topic 5.4.1) in a plain school lab (a teak bench, a blue-grey wall): one barometer, a glass tube standing in a dish of silvery mercury at 76 cm with a vacuum above, beside a cream scale in cm. One button tilts the tube 10° at a time to 40° (then stands it upright again; the arrow keys step too): the mercury fills more of the tube, but a dashed orange line from its top to the scale stays at 76; the vertical height is drawn in orange, one outlined blue air-pressure arrow presses on the dish. The panel shows one short line, the vertical height and the length along the tube, and the rule (pressure depends on the vertical height, P = hρg). Test tab: 3 questions (the vertical height at two tilts, read off the scale; why it stays the same), every wrong choice with its own note. Split from torricelli-barometer. Phone-first, Bangla and English.
